# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c24 P0](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 c24 P0](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0000), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 c24 P0](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c24 P0](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0000), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an exceptionally ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has tow-colored, lank hair, green eyes, a big mouth, and prominent ears. He possesses an intellectual brow, inspired eyes, and a very lovely, adorable speaking voice.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He is an earnest, tender, and deeply spiritual man who takes his calling as a minister very seriously. Despite his serious sense of duty, he possesses a jovial, good-tempered disposition and enjoys jokes and laughter. He is completely unpretentious and devoted to helping others, possessing a beautiful soul.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P13](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0013)_

## Goals

- To serve as a minister and help people in the slum missions  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College and St. Columbia to prepare for the ministry. While serving a summer mission at Prospect Point, he met Philippa Gordon, who nicknamed him 'Jonas' and 'Jo.' Though at first hesitant to pursue her due to his poverty and her wealthy background, his sincerity and earnest preaching won her affection. After graduating, he took charge of a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. He married Philippa Gordon in June following their graduation, and later attended the wedding of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe at Green Gables, where he delivered the nuptial prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)_
